title.narrative: Fitantanana Maharitra Holovain-jafy (FMH) (Sustainable management for future generations) Project

description.narrative: A holistic approach centered on community-based conservation, seeking to increase natural capital as a means to achieve long-term sustainability. Interventions will support residents living near eight protected areas in Madagascar to sustainably improve their livelihoods and thereby reduce poverty through improved productivity, even under periods of increased environmental and socio-economic stress, while simultaneously supporting forest protection.

sector.narrative: The FMH project aims to reduce the rate of ecosystem loss (primarily forest) in the zone of influence around communities receiving interventions, where all communities border a terrestrial protected area.

policy-marker.narrative: The project includes engagement with local government to support implementation of interventions, and engagement with national government to sensitize for receipt of end-of-project analysis of intervention impacts, but no specific policy impact is targeted during the project.
